name: Haggai
author: Haggai.
setting: Returned exiles have neglected the temple.
theme: Put God first, and he will be with his people.

outline.label: The first message: rebuild the temple
The second message: the coming glory
From this day I will bless you

christInBook: The promise that the glory of the latter house will be greater than the former (2:9) is fulfilled when Christ comes to the temple. Zerubbabel, a descendant of David, is a sign of the coming king.
howToRead: Haggai has four short messages, each dated precisely. Watch how God moves the people from self-concern to obedience and from discouragement to hope.
